messages:
Samir Patel: Heads-up — BlueRidge needs a hardened pilot for a UK bank. They want a runbook, VPC peering diagram, static egress IPs, 365-day log retention, and a committed pricing quote. Can we assemble a single package today? @Rachel @Lee @Marco @Priya
Rachel Kim: On it. I'll draft the runbook template + onboarding checklist and include a test plan.
Lee Torres: I can do the network diagram and minimal firewall/CIDR list. Do they require pinned egress IPs or just allowlist?
Samir Patel: They require pinned egress IPs (for their firewall) and EU data residency. Also p99 SLA target is <350ms.
Lee Torres: Example snippet for their infra team to use: ```yaml
vpc_peering:
  cidr_allowlist:
    - 10.50.0.0/16
    - 198.51.100.0/24
  egress_ips:
    - 3.101.22.45
    - 3.101.22.46
```
Marco Nguyen: For pricing I need expected steady-state qps and avg tokens per request. Samir do you have an estimate?
Samir Patel: They expect ~20 rps steady, ~200 tokens avg, with short bursts up to 50 rps. Usage pattern is mostly chat-style inference.
Marco Nguyen: Ok — rough committed capacity calc coming. I'll prepare three tiers and include a co-sell rebate (10%) + an optional quantized fallback to lower-cost nodes. I'll share a sheet: https://redwood.example/sheets/blueridge-quote
Priya Raman: I'll take the security questionnaire. They asked about SOC2 status, encryption (at rest + in transit), KMS/HSM, and SIEM integration. Also want proof of EU data residency.
Rachel Kim: Runbook sections I'll include: scope, preflight checklist, creds & secrets flow, test prompts & success criteria, rollback steps, monitoring hooks for Redwood Console, and contact matrix.
Samir Patel: @DeployBot can you run the staging perf job we discussed and post sample latencies for dedicated-n1-gpu-8?
DeployBot: Deployment kicked off... Deployment succeeded: staging/blue-ridge-poc -> dedicated-n1-gpu-8. Latency samples: p50=120ms p95=290ms p99=430ms. Note: p99 currently exceeds the 350ms target.
Lee Torres: 430ms p99 is above their SLA. Options: reduce context window, enable KV caching for common prefixes, tweak batching, or move to a lower-latency model variant.
Marco Nguyen: We should propose a canary plan: primary (low-latency variant) + fallback to quantized cheaper model with auto-failover. I'll add that as an optional line item in the quote.
Priya Raman: For logs/audit: we can provide daily S3 export plus syslog or Splunk forwarding. I'll draft the questionnaire responses and mark any items that need legal sign-off (e.g., subprocessor list, DPA).
Samir Patel: Action items summary: Rachel = runbook + tests, Lee = network diagram + egress list, Marco = tiered pricing + fallback option, Priya = security questionnaire draft. Target: first draft by EOD PT so we can schedule partner walkthrough tomorrow.
Rachel Kim: :thumbsup: I'll create a checklist in the partner folder and ping when the doc is ready.
Lee Torres: :eyes: I'll need the bank's CIDR block and their egress IP allowlist from BlueRidge as soon as partner gets it.
Marco Nguyen: I'll upload a sample price calc and attach the sheet link in this thread once ready.
Priya Raman: Note — KMS/HSM requirement may push this to Private deployment mode; I'll flag in the questionnaire and include migration steps.
Samir Patel: Great. If we can get those drafts today we can run a dry walkthrough with BlueRidge tomorrow morning. Thanks team.
